sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) is recorded as conditional at the latest change board (2026-10-02). No later document lifts this. Moving BR-180 deliveries to Pinerolo is new business for them, so it is blocked while the conditional status stands.

sources.quote: Temporary permit to accept BR-180 brackets from Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C)

findings.why: No controlled approval record covers Chisone, BR-180 and Pinerolo for any customer. The only BR-180 document is DEV-114, which has expired, and it was about Beinasco-era hardness acceptance. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether a release exists for Pinerolo. The customer is inferred from DEV-114 (Aurelia resident engineer) and should be confirmed.
